label: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE (Fixture Co): counterexample: a ten-question recall quiz offered as the only evidence for application and analysis objectives.

objectives.text: Calculate markup, contribution margin and weekly gross profit for store items with spreadsheet formulas built from cell references.
objectives.construct: applying markup and gross profit calculations in a spreadsheet

objectives.text: Query a sales table to compare revenue by item and by week, and explain which item drives profit.
objectives.construct: analyzing sales data with SQL queries

tasks.prompt: Ten multiple-choice questions: define markup, define margin, name the SQL keyword for totals.
